t2.thesis: Near-coin-flip: a beaten-down, heavily shorted AI-hosting name with strong analyst support and a sector selloff may bounce into the print, but WULF has fallen on 3 of its last 4 prints and sector financing fears persist.
reasons: Base rate ~54% for BMO; the entry open is the day before the print, so the window captures a ~1-day pre-earnings drift plus the overnight gap into the print
Stock is down 20% in a month and 59% below its 52-week high, with 30% short interest; mean-reversion and short-squeeze potential
Fresh positive news (Google backstop, Fluor EPC, upsized revolver, Muskie 1 GW) and Morgan Stanley and Rosenblatt bullish calls
Negative: sector financing and midterm-driven AI data-center fears, WULF fell 4% on Nov 4 despite good news, 1 of the last 4 prints was a win, and recent EPS misses
The implied move of ~11.6% is large and symmetric; the options skew gives no directional signal
t2.deciding_variable: Sector sentiment on AI-hosting financing (CIFR, IREN, CoreWeave moves on Nov 5) and the tone of Nov 6 pre-market for the gap.

prior.from: I3 overall buy-everything hit rate (0.541/0.542) and BMO session 0.548; crypto_proxy cluster (n=8, 0.25) is insufficient so ignored

t2.leak_probe: I don't know. Today is 2026-11-04, so the 2026-11-06 earnings report hasn't happened yet, and I have no information on how WULF (TeraWulf) stock moved afterward.
t2.moved_from_prior: Down about 2 points from 0.54: the sector selloff and weak earnings-reaction history roughly offset the oversold and short-interest bounce potential.

theses.expected: Rise: oversold bounce and a squeeze ahead of the print
theses.mechanism: 30% short interest, a depressed price, and a sector rebound lift the stock between the Nov 5 and Nov 6 opens
theses.wrong_if: Peers like IREN or CoreWeave sell off further on Nov 5 and the sector financing fears intensify

theses.expected: Fall: the print disappoints on EPS and financing detail
theses.mechanism: EPS misses (-23% last quarter), capex and debt needs, and the Google backstop only taking effect at final delivery leave the market unconvinced
theses.wrong_if: Management announces financing closure or a new tenant and the stock gaps up

theses.expected: Flat to small move, with direction decided by the sector
theses.mechanism: Fundamentals (HPC leasing ramp) are already priced in; the reaction follows AI-infra beta
theses.wrong_if: A company-specific surprise such as a new lease or guidance change dominates

key_observations: Nov 5 sector price action for CIFR, IREN, CRWV and bitcoin
Financing update and timing of the Justified project debt
New lease or tenant commentary and Lake Mariner CB-4 delivery timing
HPC revenue vs the ~$31.9M prior quarter
